status: Canonical x86_64 RPM builds and installed runtime/SDK/artifact qualification passed on all three distributions. OBS revision 1 uploaded and verified; native OBS/ARM qualification pending; publication disabled.

command:
set -eu
mkdir -p /work/home /work/rpmbuild
rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME} %{EPOCHNUM}:%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}.%{ARCH}\n' | sort > /work/installed-packages.txt
exec rpmbuild "$@"

steps.name: sdk-consumer
command:
unset QORE_MODULE_DIR QORE_MODULE_DIR_ONLY QORE_INCLUDE_DIR LD_LIBRARY_PATH LD_PRELOAD
unset QORE_DATA_PROVIDERS QORE_CONNECTION_PROVIDERS QORE_DATASOURCE_PROVIDERS QORE_PROVIDER_INDEX_DIR
export QORE_PDF_REQUIRE_PDFIUM=1 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
sh debian/tests/compiler

steps.name: sdk-artifacts
command:
unset QORE_MODULE_DIR QORE_MODULE_DIR_ONLY QORE_INCLUDE_DIR LD_LIBRARY_PATH LD_PRELOAD
unset QORE_DATA_PROVIDERS QORE_CONNECTION_PROVIDERS QORE_DATASOURCE_PROVIDERS QORE_PROVIDER_INDEX_DIR
export QORE_PDF_REQUIRE_PDFIUM=1 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
python3 -B -W error - <<'CHECK'
import importlib.util,pathlib,subprocess
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('aot','/aot.py')
aot=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(aot)
provider=pathlib.Path('/usr/lib64/qore-modules/PdfDataProvider/PdfDataProvider.qmod')
assert b'QAMD' in aot.read_trailers(provider)
native=list(pathlib.Path('/usr/lib64/qore-modules').glob('pdf-api-*.qmod'))
assert len(native)==1,native
for binary in [provider,*native]:
    sections=subprocess.check_output(['readelf','-S',str(binary)],text=True)
    assert '.gnu_debuglink' in sections and '.debug_info' not in sections,binary
payload=pathlib.Path('debug-payload');payload.mkdir()
for p in pathlib.Path('/rpms/rpmbuild/RPMS').rglob('*-debug*.rpm'):
    data=subprocess.check_output(['rpm2cpio',str(p)])
    subprocess.run(['cpio','-idm','--quiet'],input=data,cwd=payload,capture_output=True,check=True)
for name in ['PdfDataProvider.qm','PdfDocument.cpp']:
    assert list(payload.glob('usr/src/debug/**/'+name)),name
for binary in [provider,*native]:
    debug=list(payload.glob('usr/lib/debug/**/'+binary.name+'*.debug'))
    assert len(debug)==1,(binary,debug)
    assert '.debug_info' in subprocess.check_output(['readelf','-S',str(debug[0])],text=True)
print('PASS: native/provider separate debug symbols, source and AOT metadata')
CHECK

steps.name: runtime-install
command:
set -eu
dnf -y --nogpgcheck --setopt=install_weak_deps=False install qpdf openssl dejavu-sans-fonts "$@"
rpm -U --replacepkgs --includedocs /rpms/rpmbuild/RPMS/noarch/qore-pdf-module-doc-*.rpm
rpm -qa | sort

steps.name: runtime-tests
command:
unset QORE_MODULE_DIR QORE_MODULE_DIR_ONLY QORE_INCLUDE_DIR LD_LIBRARY_PATH LD_PRELOAD
unset QORE_DATA_PROVIDERS QORE_CONNECTION_PROVIDERS QORE_DATASOURCE_PROVIDERS QORE_PROVIDER_INDEX_DIR
export QORE_PDF_REQUIRE_PDFIUM=1 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8

for package in qore-devel gcc gcc-c++ libpdfium-qore-devel; do
    if rpm -q "$package"; then exit 1; fi
done
rpm -V qore-pdf-module qore-pdf-module-doc libpdfium-qore148-0
for suite in /usr/share/doc*/qore-pdf-module-doc/examples/*.qtest /usr/share/doc/packages/qore-pdf-module-doc/examples/*.qtest; do
    test -f "$suite" || continue
    test "$(head -n 1 "$suite")" = '#!/usr/bin/qore'
    test -x "$suite"
done
for suite in test/*.qtest; do
    timeout 300 qore -b --enable-debug -l pdf \
        -l /usr/lib64/qore-modules/PdfDataProvider/PdfDataProvider.qmod "$suite" -v
done
